paragraphs.opening:
Dear State Hearings Division,

I am writing under Manual of Policies and Procedures (MPP) 22-001 to request a state hearing on the denial of my CalFresh recertification, which I received on {{denialDate}}. I believe the denial was procedurally improper for the reasons set out below and ask that my CalFresh benefits be continued pending the hearing under MPP 22-072.
paragraphs.missedInterview: The denial cites my failure to appear at the scheduled CalFresh recertification interview. I respectfully disagree that this is a valid basis for denial. 7 CFR 273.2(e)(3) requires the county to schedule another interview on my request and prohibits denial for failure to appear without first allowing the household an opportunity to be interviewed. I am willing and available to complete an interview at the county's convenience.
paragraphs.missingDocuments: The denial cites my failure to provide one or more requested verifications. I respectfully ask the county to distinguish between a household's failure to provide verification and refusal to cooperate, as required by 7 CFR 273.2(d)(1). Failure alone is not a valid basis for procedural denial without first giving me an opportunity to explain and to produce the verification.
paragraphs.noResponse: The denial cites my failure to respond to a county request. I respectfully ask the county to verify that the request was issued in accordance with 7 CFR 273.13 (notice requirements) and MPP 22-072 (notice of action), including a current and accurate mailing address on file. If the county's request did not reach me, I have not failed to cooperate within the meaning of 7 CFR 273.2(d).
paragraphs.otherProcedural: I believe the denial was procedurally improper. I am requesting a state hearing so the basis for the denial can be reviewed against the procedural protections of 7 CFR 273.2 and California MPP 22-001.
paragraphs.failureVsRefusalArgument: Federal regulation 7 CFR 273.2(d) explicitly distinguishes a household's failure to cooperate — which alone is not grounds for denial — from refusal to cooperate, which requires an affirmative act demonstrating the household will not take steps it can take to complete the application process. I have not refused to cooperate with the county. I am ready to complete any step the county requires to continue my CalFresh benefits.
paragraphs.closing: I ask that the State Hearings Division review this denial against the standards of 7 CFR 273.2 and California MPP 22-001 and 22-072, and that my CalFresh benefits be continued pending the hearing. I can be reached at {{claimantPhone}} or {{claimantEmail}}.
